articles.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
articles.snippet: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

articles.title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
articles.snippet: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

articles.title: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.

articles.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

articles.title: $8 Million Crypto Kidnapping Lands Texas Brothers 15-Year Prison Terms
articles.snippet: Raymond and Isiah Garcia held a Minnesota family at gunpoint for more than nine hours, forcing the father to transfer over $8 million in crypto, in one of the clearest “wrench attack” prosecutions yet.
